description: Time tracking and project management software that helps teams track time, manage projects, and streamline invoicing.
auth_notes: OAuth2 is used for multi-user public integrations, and Personal Access Tokens (Bearer tokens) are used for private apps/scripts.
credential_notes: Developers can create a Harvest account with a free 30-day trial and register apps or generate personal access tokens via the developer profile, but ongoing API access requires a paid plan.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering timesheets, projects, tasks, clients, invoices, expenses, users, roles, estimates, and reports.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Harvest; community servers may exist.
rationale: Harvest provides a robust public REST API and self-serve developer access via a trial, but requires a paid subscription for long-term API usage.
